historical_record.description: A one-story, single-family dwelling stood at the property.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition of a one-story, single-family dwelling.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the construction of a three-story-over-garage two-family dwelling.
